prompts.prompt: Create a replacement unarmored RPG paper-doll base sprite. Image 1 is STYLE reference: match its very chunky low-resolution old-school pixel clusters, limited earthy palette, white hair and readable compact face. Image 2 is POSE AND ALIGNMENT template only: preserve front-facing symmetrical standing pose and exact body landmark positions, silhouette and canvas proportions. Replace realistic anatomy rendering with deliberate very low resolution pixel art: roughly 80 pixels across by 120 pixels tall at native art resolution enlarged with exact nearest-neighbor square blocks, 16-24 colors total, 2-3 solid color shades per material, NO painterly tiny texture, NO smooth gradients, NO anti-aliasing, NO realistic facial detail. Adult adventurer with short white hair and visible simple face, plain fitted dark brown sleeveless tunic and fitted dark charcoal trousers, bare feet and bare forearms. Hands closed same position as template. Canvas 1024x1536, character head top y80, chin y280, shoulders y320, waist y700, hands y820, feet bottom y1430, central x512, feet centers x360 and665. Genuine transparent alpha background with zero glow, no shadows, no scene, no text. Main requirement is visibly chunky pixels matching first reference, with the exact template proportions so clothing overlays will fit.

Edit the FIRST reference image only: it is the head equipment atlas for a pixel art game. Reference 2 is STYLE ONLY. Redraw ALL items on the atlas in chunky low-resolution pixel art matching reference 2: deliberate large square pixel clusters, simple 2-3 shade ramps, strong dark pixel outlines, very limited earthy palette, no fine painterly texture, no smooth gradients. Each item should look drawn at approximately 24 to 36 pixels tall then enlarged with nearest-neighbor blocks. CRITICAL preserve the original atlas canvas size 1619x971, every item's exact location, approximate bounding box, order, count, direction and silhouette. Do not rearrange or add/delete items. No labels, grid lines or text. Truly transparent alpha everywhere outside items; no glow, backdrop or ground shadows. All OPEN headgear including cowls, hoods, chain hoods and plated hoods MUST have genuinely transparent face holes, not opaque black interiors: a character face must be visible when layered behind. Closed full-face helmets may retain metal faceplates.
